tags: sunset, orange sky, evening, backlighting, long shadows, warm light
note: Warmth is placed in the HIGHLIGHTS (rh up, bh down) with shadows left faintly cool, so the sky and the lit edges go orange while shaded sides stay blue - that contrast is what makes it read as a low sun rather than as an overall warm wash. This is the difference from the existing golden preset, which warms the whole frame uniformly. Measured input 128 -> 143,129,104, input 40 -> 25,27,31.
